summary: A generative Berlin School sequencer whose voices loop at unequal lengths, phase against each other and mutate over time. The FM-1 makes no sound itself: it sends each voice as MIDI to external synths.
features: Each voice on its own MIDI channel over USB
Plays the same notes as Berlinan for macOS for a given template and seed
MIDI clock master, or follows clock from USB or TRS
Seven panel pages, six save slots kept across power-off
No harmony modes, melody, MIDI echo, Link or capture
Projects don't transfer between the Mac app and the FM-1
